rule: Run unittest discover using python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_*.py' with offline mock fixtures.

rule: Specify explicit providerInstanceId and model target when delegating subagents with mode async. Re-dispatch a fresh task immediately if the child task drops or returns task_not_found instead of polling stale thread IDs.
evidence: Delegated review subagent node:delegated-task:...:ac55a87a dropped with task_not_found; re-dispatching with explicit providerInstanceId pi and model 9router/ag/gemini-3.8-flash completed successfully.

rule: Assign an explicit non-zero port or resolve the dynamic port before passing FACTORY_HOST_URL to backend. Passing port 0 causes hostOrigin in backend config to throw Invalid FACTORY_HOST_URL and exit immediately.
evidence: apps/backend/src/config.ts hostOrigin validation rejected FACTORY_HOST_URL=http://127.0.0.1:0 with exit code 1 during launcher startup.

rule: Throw native_source_unavailable when archon CLI binaries are missing during lap reads. Returning an empty array masks missing engine prerequisites and breaks the fail-closed invariant.
evidence: Review finding in apps/engine-host/src/native.ts:137 caught silent return [] masking missing engine CLI as zero runs.

rule: Drain daemon stdout and stderr concurrently, and bound waits for EOF with process termination in finally. Reading an entire daemon stream before reaching its cleanup can prevent cleanup from ever running.
evidence: .git/factory-local-loop/runs/aa431cf4-ea45-43e0-967c-65475e73e55d/0-builder-session/2026-10-30T10-48-06-741Z_01a18c6c-8d55-75ce-b212-14c5b3f2bddb.jsonl records the 10:56:19Z diagnostic awaiting backend.stderr before backend.kill; state.json records exitCode 137.

rule: Inject an offline forge transport or test-owned CLI fixture for intake integration checks, without adding production fixture overrides. Keep live GitHub discovery outside offline tests.
